odysseus_fullbody.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: TRANSPARENT full-body expression and gesture sprite atlas for the existing pixel-art Godot Odyssey game.
Reference image 1 establishes ODYSSEUS'S face, long swept-back dark wavy hair with a few grey strands, dark greying beard, red cloak with round gold clasp, dark short tunic and bronze breastplate, bronze forearm bracers. Preserve this SAME man and detailed pixel-art rendering. Reference image 2 shows crew clothing context only. Make FOUR new head-to-toe versions of Odysseus, on a true transparent background, in a clean equal 2 columns x 2 rows grid. Each cell must contain exactly ONE complete standing figure, including both legs and both feet. Not a portrait sheet. Extend the established costume naturally to leather belt, short dark Greek tunic/skirt under breastplate, bare knees, bronze greaves and leather sandals. Small scratches from previous battle remain, but no fresh blood focus.
Direction: he is a resolute captain braced on a ship in a storm, deliberately projecting confidence and control to reassure his crew, without sadness or tears. Upright posture, shoulders back, feet firmly planted slightly apart, wind gently draws red cape and hair behind him. Faces three-quarter RIGHT in all four frames.
Frames in reading order:
TOP LEFT frame 0: calm firm confidence, level brow, steady narrowed eyes, closed mouth, hands relaxed at belt, attentive leadership, no worried eyes.
TOP RIGHT frame 1: decisive spoken command, mouth slightly open as projecting over wind, firm gaze, one forearm raised with open guiding palm, NOT angry screaming.
BOTTOM LEFT frame 2: navigational instruction, one arm pointing deliberately forward/right toward the destination with controlled gesture, chin raised, focused self-assured expression.
BOTTOM RIGHT frame 3: firm reassurance and promise of success, one open palm forward at waist/chest height as if steadying and reassuring crew, slight determined confident half smile, brave collected stance.
Style: crisp richly detailed cinematic pixel art with controlled pixel clusters and dithering, matching reference, bronze and crimson costume, readable faces, storm-blue cool edge highlights and subtle warm bronze reflections.
Atlas layout: rectangular canvas 1536 wide x 2048 high, equal 768x1024 cells. Identical character scale and foot baseline in ALL frames. Every complete silhouette, hair, fingers, cape, legs, and sandals stays inside its own cell with generous transparent margin at least 40px around silhouette. No overlap, no feet cut off, no floating truncated bodies. Same adult proportions across frames.
Constraints: TRUE ALPHA transparent background, no floor, no ship, no scenery, no shadows painted outside figure, no grid lines, no text, no labels, no watermark, no crying, no tears, no sorrow, no pleading, no hand clutching chest in grief, no exaggerated rage, no head-only or bust portraits. Entire body visible for ALL FOUR frames.
odysseus_fullbody.layout_edit:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this full-body Odysseus sprite atlas ONLY to fix the atlas framing and spacing. Preserve the same pixel-art, face identity, bronze armor, red cloak, costume, all four gestures and confident emotions. Keep TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY.
The existing sheet has figures and fingers almost touching or crossing quadrant boundaries, so it is not usable as a 2x2 atlas. Fix this.
Use a SQUARE 2048x2048 canvas divided into 4 equal invisible 1024x1024 cells, reading order unchanged. Reduce ALL FOUR characters uniformly so their full head-to-sandal height is about 800 pixels, leaving at least 100px clear transparent margin above heads and below feet and at least 60px to either side of every hand and cape. Center each entire silhouette within its own cell, with the same head height and foot baseline relative to the cell. The bottom-left pointing HAND MUST BE FULLY CONTAINED WITHIN THE BOTTOM LEFT CELL, ending well BEFORE the canvas vertical midpoint. The top-right outstretched HAND MUST be fully contained with margin before the right canvas edge. No finger, cloak, hair or boot may touch or cross any cell edge. All heads, arms, legs and feet fully visible. No partial neighboring sprites at frame edges. Keep compact gestures if necessary to ensure this.
Do not add grid lines, labels, text, floor, background or shadows outside the figure. Do not turn these into cropped portraits. No tears or sadness; keep a confident, composed commander in every frame.

eurylochus_fullbody.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: TRANSPARENT full-body gesture/expression sprite atlas for Eurylocus, a speaking officer aboard Odysseus's ship in a pixel-art Godot Odyssey game.
Reference is an existing character sheet. Use ONLY the man in the TOP TWO frames as EURYLOCUS identity and costume: medium wavy dark brown hair, shorter dark beard, younger than Odysseus, red cloak with two bronze fasteners, bronze armor with leather shoulder strips, bronze bracers. Do NOT use the helmeted sailor in the lower frames. Make this same Eurylocus as FOUR complete head-to-toe standing figures on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Extend his outfit naturally into belted short Greek military tunic/leather skirt, bare knees, greaves and leather sandals.
Emotion: Eurylocus is worried about the huge waves and the fleet, asks the captain urgently, but remains an adult trained soldier. He is NOT crying or collapsing. All figures face three-quarter LEFT, so they can face Odysseus standing to the left in-game. Feet braced on a rocking ship, red cape and hair gently drawn to the right by wind.
Four frames in reading order:
TOP LEFT 0: alert listening, brow slightly tense, mouth closed, hands near belt, controlled stance.
TOP RIGHT 1: urgent worried warning 'Capitão, vamos virar...', mouth open speaking, brow furrowed, one open palm gesturing at the dangerous sea; concern, not tears.
BOTTOM LEFT 2: balancing against a wave, knees bent slightly, arms held briefly out for balance, startled but controlled.
BOTTOM RIGHT 3: hearing the captain's reassurance, still concerned but gathering courage, standing firm, chin lifted, hands settling at belt.
Style: dense crisp cinematic PIXEL ART with dithering and controlled pixel clusters matching reference; bronze, crimson, dark leather and cool storm-blue rimlight. Same character and proportions throughout.
Atlas layout is CRITICAL: SQUARE canvas 2048x2048 with equal 2x2 invisible cells of 1024x1024. Every figure's complete silhouette is about 800px tall including BOTH feet. Transparent margin above heads and below sandals at least 100px. Identical head height and foot baseline within ALL cells. No head, cape, finger or foot may touch or cross cell borders. Entire extended gestures remain inside the assigned cell with generous margin. Center each figure inside its cell; gestures compact enough to fit.
Constraints: true ALPHA transparency, no background, no floor, no ship, no cast shadows outside the body, no gridlines, no text, no watermark. No cropped busts. All four full bodies, hands, legs, feet and sandals FULLY visible. No helmets. Do not change the established face.
